{{Quote|I welcome you as a servant of the people, but I am troubled by the false rumors that brought you here.|Almec to Obi-Wan Kenobi|audio=ServantOfThePeople-TMP.flac|<ref name="TMP" />}}
'''Almec''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], and a member of the peaceful [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Almec served in the New Mandalorian [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|government]] as [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]], taking up residence in the New Mandalorians' [[Domed city/Legends|domed]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. A supporter of New Mandalorian ruler, [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine]], Almec was a firm believer in the New Mandalorians' peaceful ways and did as he thought best to watch over and represent the interests of Mandalore. His dedication to his people became his undoing, however, as when Mandalore was cut off from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] aid, Almec took it upon himself to establish a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] trade network of illicit [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to bring much needed goods to the New Mandalorian people. [[Moogan/Legends|These smugglers]] [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] the people of Sundari with [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]]-tainted [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|tea]], putting numerous [[Youngling/Legends|children]] in [[Sundari Mandalorian hospital/Legends|the hospital]]. Almec was exposed as the leader of the black market network, and therefore one of the parties responsible for the children's poisoning, and was summarily [[Royal prison/Legends|imprisoned]] for his crimes.

When [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|took over]] Sundari around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he broke Almec out of prison and reinstated Almec as [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]] over [[Armatan/Legends|Armatan]] after Maul disposed of [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Mandalore would never turn against the Republic. The Duchess Satine values ''peace'' more than her own life.|Almec to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="TMP" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], Almec was a member of the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] and a strong supporter of their peaceful ways.<ref name="TCWCE" /> By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Almec had become the New Mandalorians' [[Prime Minister/Legends|Prime Minister]], serving at the head of the [[Ruling Council (New Mandalorians)/Legends|Ruling Council]] of [[minister]]s that comprised the New Mandalorian government.<ref name="Corruption">{{TCW|Corruption (episode)}}</ref> Around the year [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> he met with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] upon his arrival on Mandalore, in the New Mandalorian [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]]. Kenobi had been sent by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] to ascertain the truth behind rumors that [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]], leader of the New Mandalorians, was building a Mandalorian [[Army/Legends|army]] to fight for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], although Almec assured the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] that these rumors were false. He wholeheartedly believed that Mandalore would never turn against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], stating that the infamous violence of the Mandalorians was confined to their past. When Kenobi mentioned his [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)/Legends|encounter]] with the Mandalorian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], Almec<ref name="TMP" />&mdash;either unaware of, or unwilling to accept the fact that Fett had been the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']], the traditional leader of the Mandalorians' warrior clans<ref name="Open Seasons">''[[Star Wars: Jango Fett: Open Seasons]]''</ref><ref name="O66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>&mdash;dismissed him as nothing but a mere [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who'd acquired his [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|armor]] by unknown means.<ref name="TMP" />

[[File:ObiWanEvidence-TMP.png|thumb|left|220px|Almec appalled at the evidence of Mandalorian involvement in the war]]
During Kenobi's audience with Duchess Satine Kryze, Almec spoke out when the Jedi Master presented a [[Hologram/Legends|recording]] of a [[Unidentified Death Watch saboteur/Legends|Mandalorian saboteur]] responsible for an [[Attack on a Republic cruiser/Legends|attack]] on a [[Unidentified Republic cruiser|Republic cruiser]], declaring that no Mandalorian would perpetrate such an attack. Although the Prime Minister expressed interest in the whereabouts of the Mandalorian in question, he appeared quite shocked when Kenobi revealed that the man had chosen [[Death/Legends|suicide]] rather than submit to questioning. Following the revelation that the saboteur was a member of the resurgent group known as the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]]<ref name="TMP" />&mdash;a Mandalorian splinter-faction intent on returning the Mandalorians their [[Mandalorian Crusaders|ancient ways]], with the ultimate goal of starting another [[Mandalorian Wars|war of conquest]]<ref name="Open Seasons" />&mdash;and that the once trusted ally [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] of Mandalore's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Concordia/Legends|Concordia]], was now leading the Death Watch, Almec was part of the cadre of retainers and guards that escorted Kryze to her personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], for her trip to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TMP" /> There, she hoped to convince the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] that the Death Watch did not represent the views of the entire Mandalorian community.<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

While the Duchess spoke on behalf of her people in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber|Senate chamber]], Almec remained on Mandalore. It was there that he received a troubling report from a [[Unidentified New Mandalorian scout/Legends|Mandalorian scout]]: the Death Watch was amassing an army at [[Death Watch hideout|their base]] on Concordia. Almec agreed with the scout's assessment that the Death Watch would be unable to take over Mandalore without the popular backing of its residents, although he also surmised that were the Republic to deploy a [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|military force]] as they [[Mandalore Defense Resolution/Legends|planned]] to do, it would drive the people to support the Death Watch as liberators standing against foreign oppressors. Left with no other recourse, Almec could only place his trust in Duchess Satine's efforts, trust that was rewarded when the Duchess convinced the Senate against sending an occupying force of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troops]] to Mandalore.<ref name="DoM" />

[[File:ForcedConfession2-TA.png|thumb|right|250px|Almec attempts to force Duchess Satine to sign a confession of conspiracy.]]
The Duchess' efforts successfully allowed Mandalore to remain free of entanglement in the Clone Wars, but it's neutrality came at the cost of losing vital Republic aid in the form of supply shipments.<ref name="Corruption" /> In response, Almec took it upon himself to [[Mandalorian black market conspiracy/Legends|establish a network]] of [[Black market/Legends|black market]] trade in order to ensure the continuing importation of much needed supplies for the New Mandalorian people.<ref name="TA">{{TCW|The Academy}}</ref> At a later point in [[Time/Legends|time]], Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] came to Sundari to assure the New Mandalorian government that aide would come from sympathetic parties within the Senate. During her stay, Amidala, together with Kryze, discovered the illegal [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ring circumventing the previous loss of Republic trade, when it was revealed to endanger the lives of Mandalorian [[Youngling/Legends|children]]. The [[Moogan/Legends|Moogan]] smugglers moving the goods had diluted imported [[Ardees Beverage/Legends|tea]] with the chemical [[Slabin/Legends|slabin]], which in the high doses used by the smugglers proved [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] to its consumers. Almec was informed of this development by Amidala and Kryze, though he reflectively implicated the Death Watch as the party behind the illicit activities. When the Duchess and senator shut down the smuggling ring and brought the issue of the corruption growing in the New Mandalorian government to Almec's attention, the New Mandalorians' Prime Minister offered to form a committee to further investigate the issue.<ref name="Corruption" />

Not long after, Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was invited to Mandalore in order to lecture at the New Mandalorian [[Royal Academy of Government/Legends|Royal Academy]] on the perils of corruption. She was met at the landing platform in Sundari by Almec, Kryze, and a gathering of New Mandalorian academy cadets. These cadets&mdash;[[Amis/Legends|Amis]], [[Lagos/Legends|Lagos]], [[Soniee/Legends|Soniee]], and Duchess Kryze's own nephew, [[Korkie Kryze/Legends|Korkie]]&mdash;along with Tano, uncovered Almec's involvement in the black market trade network, and thus his complicity with the poisonings of Sundari's [[Sundari Mandalorian school/Legends|school]] children. Using the [[Mandalorian secret service/Legends|New Mandalorian Secret Service]],<ref name="TA" /> over which the Prime Minister's office held authority,<ref name="SWE-Mandalorian Guard">{{SWE|groups|mandalorianguard|Mandalorian Guard}}</ref> Almec had the cadets and Tano arrested, in addition to Duchess Kryze herself upon learning that she had been informed of his involvement as well. He attempted to have the Duchess sign a confession of conspiracy, but upon being denied, Almec used a [[Shock collar/Legends|shock collar]] as a means of [[Torture/Legends|persuading]] her. When Kryze refused to yield, he turned his attention to her nephew, Korkie; Tano and the cadets fought back, managing to overpower Almec and his guards until he could be fitted with a shock collar, himself, forcing the Prime Minister to surrender. Almec and his conspirators were placed under arrest, and subsequently [[Royal prison/Legends|imprisoned]].<ref name="TA" />

[[File:AlmecReinstatementSpeech-SoR.png|thumb|left|250px|Almec promises to move beyond his questionable path and to lead Mandalore back to its warrior heritage as Prime Minister.]]
Some time later, after Death Watch allied with crime syndicates and the Sith brothers, [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], Kryze was overthrown in a political coup led by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]] and was imprisoned in a cell next to Almec. The former Prime Minister refused to apologize for his past actions and mocked Kryze for her beliefs. He was later recruited by the Nightbrothers, who had been betrayed by Death Watch, to stand as their puppet ruler once they had overthrown Vizsla. Maul then challenged Vizsla to an honorable death match for the allegiance of Death Watch, which he inevitably won. Almec was then reinstalled as Prime Minister and told the general populace that Satine murdered Vizsla. He then began setting up a new administration, and Maul warned that him that he would be held fully responsible for their failures.<ref name="SoR">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref> Almec was later present in the [[Sundari Royal Palace/Legends|throne room]] when Obi-Wan Kenobi was brought before Maul and bore witness to Satine's murder by Maul.<ref name="Lawless">{{TCW|The Lawless}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Master Kenobi, Mandalore's violent past is ''behind'' us.|Almec to Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="TMP" />}}
[[File:ForcedConfession-TA.png|thumb|right|250px|Almec reveals his duplicity to Duchess Satine.]]
Almec was a large man, standing at a height of 1.89 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and possessed both [[Color/Legends|blond]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and fair skin, in addition to violet-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="TCWCE" /> Almec was a firm believer in the peaceful ways of the New Mandalorians,<ref name="TMP" /> and took great pride in the success the New Mandalorian government had in renouncing the violent reputation Mandalore had held in the past. He came to resent the opinion of offworlders who associated Mandalore only with the planet's warrior clans rather than the progressive New Mandalorian society,<ref name="TCWCE" /> and in keeping with the low opinion the New Mandalorians generally held for Mandalore's warrior clans,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> he angrily dismissed<ref name="TCWCE" /> the former ''Mand'alor'' Jango Fett<ref name="O66" /> as nothing but a common bounty hunter, when questioned by Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi.<ref name="TMP" /> While he held a high-ranking office in the New Mandalorian government, Almec was a humble man, preferring simple clothes<ref name="TCWCE" /> and considering himself a servant of the people.<ref name="TMP" /> That did not change the fact that Almec was a talented, dignified [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]],<ref name="TCWCE" /> and shrewd [[Politics/Legends|politician]], able to correctly deduce the Death Watch's plans to rally favor for their cause by instigating a Republic invasion in order to appear as liberators to the Mandalorian populace.<ref name="DoM" /> Almec was a friend of the New Mandalorians' leader, Duchess Satine Kryze, and placed a great deal of faith in her leadership abilities.<ref name="DoM" />

When the New Mandalorian people were threatened with starvation after the Republic shut down [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]] to Mandalore in the face of the planet's declared neutrality, Almec took it upon himself to find a solution to the problem plaguing his people. To that end, he established an illegal black market trade network to smuggle the needed goods from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] into Sundari, but in doing so, opened himself up to the risk of greed and corruption.<ref name="TA" /> In trying to help his people, Almec instead made it possible for Moogan smugglers to poison innocent children throughout Sundari with toxin-laced [[Tea/Legends|tea]],<ref name="Corruption" /> and in trying to cover it up, turned on his long-time friend and ally Duchess Kryze and betrayed his pacifist beliefs by torturing Kryze and threatening to do the same to her young nephew, Korkie.<ref name="TA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Almec first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] episode "[[The Mandalore Plot]]," the first in a trilogy of episodes featuring the Mandalorians. He would appear again in the flashback reel at the start of the subsequent episode, "[[Voyage of Temptation]]," before making his second true appearance in the final episode of the trilogy, "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]." Almec received entries in both the ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia|''The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia'']].

Almec's hair and clothing incorporate the same hexagonal design of the small, center plate of traditional Mandalorian chest armor, and in elements of Sundari's architecture.

Almec is voiced by actor [[Julian Holloway]].<ref name="TA" />
